stem: At a restaurant 600 customers were served during a 10-hour period of time. Which graph has a slope that best represents the number of customers that were served per hour at this restaurant?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Number of Customers (0 to 700), x-axis Time (hours) 0 to 7, horizontal line at y=600

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Number of Customers (60 to 540), x-axis Time (hours) 0 to 7, line increasing diagonally from (0,0) to approximately (7,480)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Number of Customers (0 to 70), x-axis Time (hours) 0 to 7, horizontal line at y=60

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Number of Customers (60 to 540), x-axis Time (hours) 0 to 7, line increasing diagonally from (0,0) to (7,540)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, G, H, J with y-axis Number of Customers and x-axis Time (hours). F and G have horizontal lines; H and J have increasing diagonal lines.
